answer: Cedar-Delta Voyage Bank Check: each identity binds to one distinct KYC-verified bank account — a fresh government ID check plus a $25 minimum deposit per fake. Like a cedar, the anchor is slow-grown: a new account seasons 7 days before it can answer. The verifier sends a random micro-deposit on a voyage through the payment rails, and the agent must report the exact cent delta. A fake with no account cannot answer, and a wrong cent figure fails outright.
